source.branch: mattackm() skips AT_EXPL targets at distmin > 1. explmm() returns M_ATTK_MISS when magr->mcan; otherwise it reports the explosion or noise. AD_FIRE, AD_COLD, and AD_ELEC call mon_explodes() and set AGR_DIED; mon_explodes() calls mondead() before the blast. Other damage types call mdamagem(); if its result lacks AGR_DIED, explmm() calls mondead() and returns early if lifesaving leaves the aggressor alive.

mon.c:mondead() (called by mon_explodes() before the blast; reserved by A83)
mon.c:xkilled() (called by explode() when the blast kills a monster; reserved by A83)
